fixes: Footrest: canonical footrest is a square frame of four flat sticks. The brief and the ramen concept show a round hinoki ring. Replace with a 0.30-0.34 m diameter ring, 25 mm section, about 0.22 m above the floor, with 2 tie stretchers.

Cushion: canonical cushion is a flat grey disc with a small dome. Concept cushion is a soft red upholstered pad. Target a 40-50 mm thick dome with a 15 mm bevelled fabric edge and a stitched seam ring. Tint must read red (see library_issues).
Seat top: faceted edge shows polygon facets. Raise the seat revolve to 24 or more segments at LOD0 and use a two-step 12 mm edge radius.

Legs: legs are square-section with flat faces and no visible joinery. Target 8-sided legs at LOD0, a 30 mm turned bead at mid height, and a visible 10 mm shoulder/tenon where each leg meets the seat underside.

LOD3: 18-tri hexagonal prism reads as a plinth or pillar, not a stool. Keep four legs (sticks) and the round seat, about 40 tris minimum. LOD2 (80 tris) keeps the stool read; keep the footrest ring at LOD2.
library_issues: noren (cloth) renders grey-lavender or grey-brown, so the red cushion tint does not come through. The base albedo needs fixing, or a red fabric entry is needed.
lacquer_dark and hinoki: no visible issue on the stool itself, but the seat top reads flat at distance; check the wear value.
summary: The stool reads as a stool at LOD0 and LOD2, with the right height and seat width. Weak points are the square footrest, the faceted seat top and the grey cushion. LOD3 is a block and fails recognition. All three seeds look the same in the sheet and only the bar style is shown.
